title: pleurogramme linearifolia
intro: Pleurogramme linearifolia, commonly known as the "tongue fern", is a type of fern native to New Zealand and Australia. The health benefits of Pleurogramme linearifolia include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to act as a vulnerary, helping to promote wound healing and tissue repair, as well as its potential use as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Pleurogramme linearifolia include various polyphenolic compounds, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
